svg.title: RE4 status: scoped library services and PS2 hardware
svg.desc: GitHub dark treemap. Green means working in verified scope, yellow hatched means partial, gray means pending. SDK function percentages have not been measured. Independent hardware reference47 of55 is separate from candidate validation.
svg.text: RE4 SDK / runtime services*: scoped evidence
